description: W3C SCXML statechart conformance registry — the single source of truth for which upstream tests this repository runs and which harness each one needs. `sce-codegen generate-w3c --registry` reads it, `sce-codegen list-fixtures --manifest` enumerates it for build systems with no JSON parser, and tests/CMakeLists.txt derives its per-test registrations from it. Per-test prose (description, spec section, conformance level) is NOT duplicated here: it stays in resources/<id>/metadata.txt, which is upstream W3C data the generator reads separately. `summary` is this repository's own curation note, shown by `generate-w3c --list`.

harnesses.simple: Run the machine to completion and assert it settles in its pass state. The default when a fixture names no harness.
harnesses.scheduled: The machine depends on delayed `<send>` firing, so the runner needs a longer completion budget and a scheduler tick rather than a single run-to-completion step.
harnesses.http: The machine sends over BasicHTTPEventProcessor, so the runner needs the W3C HTTP fixture endpoint listening before it starts.
